item.title: 2025 JREF Award
item.description: The James Randi Educational Foundation (JREF) is pleased to name the Lilienfeld Alliance as our most recent award recipient.The JREF award is given each year to persons or organizations that best represent the spirit of the foundation and the legacy of James “The Amazing” Randi. Randi had an international reputation as a magician and escape artist, but was perhaps best known as the world’s most tireless investigator and demystifier of paranormal and pseudoscientific claims.The [...]
